LOW MIST BETWEEN THE STONES: a soft knee-high mist lying between the fallen stones, thinning to clear bright air above
VALLEY MIST BELOW THE CLIFF: a still mist pooled deep in the valley below, pale and even against the ancient stone
MIST RISING OFF WARM WATER: warm water breathing a slow thin mist upward, curling gently as it rises and spreads
THIN VEIL AMONG THE TREES: a faint mist threading softly among the trunks, barely thicker than the air around it
MIST THINNING TO CLEAR AIR: mist lying low and dissolving gently upward into perfectly clear and luminous open air above
MORNING MIST IN THE GREEN: a soft green-lit mist caught low among the mossy stones, glowing faintly in the early light
WARM GREEN HAZE: a humid golden-green haze softening the far trees into gentle layers, the near air clear
HEAVY STILL JUNGLE AIR: dense warm air hanging unmoving between the stones, thick with moisture and deep green quiet
GOLDEN HAZE OVER THE VALLEY: a soft golden haze settling over the valley floor, blurring the far ruin into warm light
SEA HAZE ALONG THE SHALLOWS: a pale sea haze drifting low and thin along the water's edge, soft and salt-warm
AIR THICK AND GLOWING: warm humid air close to the ground, heavy and glowing with a gentle diffused amber light
GOLDEN DUST HANGING STILL: fine golden dust hanging perfectly still in the warm air, each mote catching the long light
POLLEN DRIFTING SLOWLY: pale pollen drifting in a slow soft cloud, turning lazily through the quiet sunlit air
POLLEN IN THE LIT AIR: tiny pollen drifting where the warm light reaches through the green, each speck bright and slow as it turns
SAND SMOKE OFF THE DUNE CREST: a thin stream of fine sand lifting off the dune crest, trailing away in a faint golden haze
DUST SETTLING AFTER STONE SHIFTS: fine pale dust hanging in the still air, slowly settling back toward the warm ground below
SOFT DRIZZLE FALLING: a soft drizzle descending in fine dithered lines, gentle and even across the open stones
STEADY FINE RAIN: steady rain falling in fine even lines, quiet and unhurried over the ancient mossy walls
RAIN EASING TO LAST DROPS: the rain thinning to a few slow last drops, falling wide apart through the brightening air
WARM SHOWER THROUGH SUNLIGHT: a warm shower falling in fine bright lines through full sunlight, the drops glinting as they fall
EVERY STONE WET AND SHINING: rain-washed stone gleaming softly, every surface lit and wet, reflecting the open sky above
WATER BEADING FROM LEAVES: water gathered into bright beads along every leaf edge, hanging and dropping one slow drop at a time
STEAM LIFTING OFF WARM STONE: thin steam rising in quiet wisps from sun-warmed stone, lifting straight in the still air
AIR WASHED AND CLEAR: the air after rain, fully clear and clean, every far detail of the ruin sharp and quietly luminous
AFTER THE RAIN, SHARP DISTANCE: the washed air carrying far detail with perfect clarity, the stones bright and the light very still
